flagged.evidence: Clause (f) quantifies over “every compact K ⊆ Ω” and defines B_K using real suprema over K. The dependency def-compact-space states, “The empty space is compact.” For K = ∅ these real suprema are undefined, and the item supplies no convention for them, so B_K is undefined for an admitted case.

The dependency def-gr-plane-wave-perturbation allows ω ∈ ℝ, while this statement calls ωT future-directed null. For ω < 0, η(ωT, ∂₀) = −ω > 0, so ωT is past-directed; for ω = 0 it is the zero vector. The claim therefore fails for admitted values of ω.

The proof gives η(∂₀ + δ∂₂ + ∂₃, ∂₀ + δ∂₂ + ∂₃) = −1 + δ² < 0. With η = diag(−1, 1, 1, 1), the actual value is −1 + δ² + 1 = δ² > 0 for δ > 0, so those vectors are spacelike and do not establish the claimed timelike approximation to T.

[F5] attributes B_K to thm-gr-flat-linearized-curvature-and-gauge clause (f) and claims it bounds raw jets by max{1, L, L²}B_K. That dependency defines B_K(A) = sup|A| + L sup|∂A| + L² sup|∂²A|. For L = 0.1, K = {0}, and A₁₁(x) = 0.5(x¹)² with other components zero, the cited B_K is 0.01, while the raw second-derivative maximum is 1 and the claimed factor is 1. The asserted bound does not follow from the cited functional; this item’s displayed M_K instead uses inverse powers of L.
